answer: In an EigenTrust-style trust graph, reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service rather than earned once. A freshly spawned Sybil identity has little trusted incoming weight and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits fabricated endorsements from boosting it. Like a marble on a ledge above a reef, a new identity cannot gain consensus standing without durable, independently supported trust links.
